correctness.rationale: For b>1 the ray radius of the intersection is rho_b(t) for the shortest angular distance t to a nearest antipodal center, strictly increasing in t. The circular Voronoi partition and polar area identity yield A=sum F_b(gap), including coincident centers. Jensen gives the sharp regular-m-gon minimizer and b-disk coincidence maximum. Uniform i.i.d. circular angular gaps, anchored at any sampled center, have Dirichlet(1,...,1) law. Direct independent rational moment check verified Var(sum (Delta/2pi)^3)=72(m-1)(5m+11)/[(m+1)^2(m+2)^2(m+3)(m+4)(m+5)] for m=3..99. Delta method for independent exponentials gives influence E^3-18E+12 with variance 360 and thus limit 40 alpha^2 pi^6. Remainder bounded by sum gap^5 has L2 order m^-4; centering by exact expectation is justified. Theorem does not extend to interior centers or b<=1.
residual_risks: b>1, equal disk radii, i.i.d. uniform unit-circle center angles only; asymptotic CLT without finite-m rate.
